text: Ahnassi is a Khajiit monk who lives in the Imperial-constructed city of Pelagiad in the Vvardenfell region of Morrowind.
Ahaz is a Dunmer Champion who lives in Erabenimsun Camp in the Ashkhan's Yurt. He is one of the Gulakhans of the tribe and acts as a bodyguard to Ashkhan Ulath-Pal.
Ainab is a Dunmer hunter and ethnic Ashlander who resides in his yurt in the Erabenimsun Camp.
Agning is a Nord publican who runs the Six Fishes Tavern in Ebonheart, in the Ascadian Isles region.
Ahdarji is a Khajiit rogue living in Leyawiin who lost her mate, Qa-Dar, an experienced member of the Thieves Guild.

Agronak gro-Malog, commonly known as The Gray Prince, is the reigning Grand Champion at the Arena and therefore, the primary antagonist of the Arena questline. It is widely known that Agronak is only half Orc, but nobody knows what the other half is. Agronak knows his father was a noble by the name of Lord Lovidicus, but has no proof of this, and he is too busy training to take time off to find it. He wants to prove that an Orc can be noble in both blood and deed, so is looking for help in proving his lineage.
Agata is a Nord mage and spell merchant who lives in Leyawiin's Mages Guild. She sells spells and will recharge enchanted weapons for Mages Guild members for a fee.

Akaviri Commander Mishaxhi was an Akaviri warrior and the commander of the Akaviri forces when they attempted to invade Cyrodiil from the north, through Pale Pass. He was also guarding an ancient Akaviri artifact known as the Draconian Madstone which the countess of Bruma, Narina Carvain, hires the Hero to find in the quest Lifting the Vale.
Ahjazda is a Khajiit enchanter who is convinced that the world is coming to an end soon. She is the owner of the shop Things Found in Crucible.
Agnes of Glenmoril was the highest-ranking member of the Glenmoril Wyrd. Agnes was also the creator of the Scroll of the Wolf Ender which is a cure to lycanthropy.
Agrippina Herennia is an Imperial clothier who resides in the canalworks of the Foreign Quarter in Vivec City, in the Ascadian Isles.
Ahetotis Furotis is an Imperial warrior. She is a smuggler who resides in the cave of Pinsun near Vos, and is accompanied by seven other smugglers.
Aeta Wave-Breaker is a Nord commoner found in the West Gash region, in Vvardenfell, Morrowind.
Ainethach is a Breton residing in the town of Karthwasten, of which he is the leader. He also owns the local Sanuarach Mine.
Aeri is a Nord lumberjack in Anga's Mill. She lives in the mill and makes her living along with her two workers, Kodrir and Leifur.

Ahkari is a Khajiit trader who can be found anywhere between Dawnstar and Riften. She travels and sells her wares with Zaynabi, a fellow Khajiit traveler. The pair are protected by Dro'marash and Kharjo, her guards.
Aicantar is an Altmer conjurer who lives within Understone Keep. He helps his uncle, Calcelmo, in his laboratory, and is a minor antagonist during the Thieves Guild questline.
Agrius was an Imperial bandit. His corpse lies in Halldir's Cairn, Falkreath Hold, next to Raen and Vidgrod's. Agrius' journal can be found on a podium, across the chamber.
Ahjisi is a Khajiit bandit in who is one of the Hunters of Hircine sent to kill Sinding. She may be found inside Bloated Man's Grotto.
Ahrtabazus was a noted Altmer scholar during the Second Era.

Agni is a Nord child. She is an orphan and is taken care of by Falion in Morthal. She is training to become Falion's apprentice, and because of this, doesn't share the opinion of the rest of the town regarding Falion. She can be seen running around with the other children early in the morning, but mostly stays with Falion in his house during the day. Randomly a conversation can be heard between the two, where she mentions having a bad dream that Falion sneaks out at night to do scary things. When she grows up she wants to study magic at the College of Winterhold, although Falion does not approve of this.
Ahanabi Assullinbanud is a Dunmer miner who resides in Caldera Mine.
Ahasour is a Dunmer herder who resides in Urshilaku Camp. He can often be found inside his yurt with Senipu, who also appears to live there.
Ainab Yassabisun is a hostile Dunmer barbarian who can be found camping with fellow bandits east of Khuul. He is hostile towards the Nerevarine on sight.
Affri is a Khajiit slave who resides on the Arvel Plantation, in the Ascadian Isles region.
Ahdahni is a Khajiit slave who resides in the Gateway Inn in Sadrith Mora.

Ahbiilok (Dragon Language: , Ah–Bii–Lok, "Hunter–Blue–Sky") was a dragon that survived extermination during the Dragon War and the Akaviri crusades of the First Era. Sightings date back to the early years of the Akaviri Dragonguard. He was reported to be active throughout the northern Jerall Mountains. Multiple attempts were made to kill him, but all failed. He was eventually reported to have fled to Morrowind. Brarilu Theran, master Enchanter and author of Twin Secrets, reportedly met a dragon in the "smoking ruins of Vvardenfell." However, it is unknown if this dragon was Ahbiilok, as he refused to reveal his name.

The Afflicted Refugee is a randomly encountered male, wandering the roads of Skyrim. If the Dragonborn speaks to him, he will become offended, claiming that they are "ogling the grotesque." He is referring to his own skin, which is covered in black encrustations.
Agrob gra-Bogharz is an Orsimer barbarian and slaver. She resides in the slaver cave of Zainsipilu. Agrob, like the other bandits in the cave, will attack the Nerevarine on sight.
Ahnisa is a Khajiit slave who resides in the cave of Zainsipilu.

Agacephs were a breed of Argonian who lived in the innermost swamps of Black Marsh and traveled through the marshes on extremely thin rafts that they guided with their tails. They generally possessed a low opinion of the Archeins due to their meddling in slave trading with the Dunmer of Morrowind, their extortion of the other Argonians, and their assimilation into Imperial culture.
Afer Flaccus is an Imperial commoner residing in the town of Raven Rock. He is typically found inside the tavern in Raven Rock, and is employed by the East Empire Company.
Agarond is a Bosmer battlemage who resides in Zaintiraris, in the Azura's Coast region. He worships Sheogorath and can be found near his shrine. He is hostile and will attack the Nerevarine on sight.
Aeta is a Nord child living in Skaal Village. She is the daughter of Oslaf and Finna, and an aspiring hunter.
Aglaril is a Bosmer archer who resides in the tower of Hanud, in the Azura's Coast region. She is the only character in Hanud who will not attack the Nerevarine on sight.
Ahnarra is a Khajiit slave who resides in Abebaal Egg Mine. Ahnarra, as well as the rest of the slaves in the mine, is owned by House Telvanni and is in the middle of a revolt.
Ah-Meesei is an Argonian slave who resides in the cave of Kudanat.
Aina is a Khajiit slave held captive in the cave of Habinbaes in Sheogorad.
Ahdni is a Khajiit slave who resides in the cave of Sinsibadon.
Ahdri is a Khajiit slave who resides in the cave of Yakanalit.
Ahaht is an Argonian slave who resides in the cave of Yakanalit. Freeing Ahaht is possible if the Slave Key is found.
Ahndahra is a Khajiit slave who resides in the cave of Yakanalit.
Agrash is an Orsimer residing in Port Hunding, in Headman Bhosek's palace. She is being seduced by Jakarn.

Aicessar is an Altmer hall steward who resides in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard and a member of the Fighters Guild. He may also be found by the Fighters Guildhall in Shimmerene, Summerset or that in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr as well as Solitude, Western Skyrim.
Agli is an Orsimer who resides in the Stonetooth Fortress on the island of Betnikh. She has a stall in the Stonetooth Market, where she sells enchanting-related items.
Afehaba is a Khajiit member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their branch in Aldcroft.
Ainare is an Altmer Noble residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade. She likes listening to the musician Rendarion at the docks.
Ahmaron is a Redguard residing in Alcaire Castle, located inside the Old Goat Inn.
Aizar is a Redguard armorer residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. He has a stall, Aizar's Helms and Hauberks in the Merchant District, where he sells his wares.
Ah-Zish is an Argonian residing in Wayrest in Stormhaven. She is a trader for the Fighters Guild, and has a stand at the Guild Traders market.
Aerchith is a Bosmer residing in Wayrest in Stormhaven. She is a guild trader, and has her stand at the Guild Traders market.
Aesril is an Altmer residing in Skywatch in Auridon. He own the store Breeze Weavers in town with Ulando and Sircantir.

Ahnia is a Khajiit assassin found in the Bazaar Sewers. After speaking to Ten-Tongues Weerhat about the price of goods, it is revealed that Ahnia is the supplier of his stolen goods. If spoken to about it, she will become hostile towards the Nerevarine.
Afeh is a Senche-Tiger in . She should be cleaning the Laughing Moons Plantation of rats, but she is too lazy to do so. Her handler is Cinder-Tail.
Aeren is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Mournhold.

Agrippa Mento is a retired scout of the Imperial Legion. He resides in his house, located across the river from Castle Alessia. He has no intention to ever return to the Legion and worries not of any casualties the Soulburst and Three Banners War will create, having been traumatized over the loss of his fellow soldiers.
Agrippa Priscus is an Imperial who resides in the Redfur Trading Post, in the region of Grahtwood.
Ahuziq is a Redguard magus who appears in the Tal'Deic Fortress, in Deshaan.
Akhita is a Redguard Fighters Guild member residing in the towns of Baandari Trading Post, Bergama, and Windhelm.
Agwodir is a Bosmer armsman and member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Belkarth in Craglorn.
Aideh al-Satakalaam is a Redguard carpenter and proprietor of The Alik'r Desert's Rare Woods found at The Forebear's Forge, residing in the city of Sentinel.
Ahya is a Redguard merchant who resides in the city of Evermore, Bangkorai. During waking hours, she is usually found at the Stalls, where she owns and operates the stall Dockside Sundries.
Akethi is a Khajiit blacksmith and member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their branch in Kragenmoor, where she also sells her wares.
Ahirneriba is a Khajiit slave found in Kragenmoor. She can be found in one of the slave quarters, and has no unique dialogue.
Aerchelas is a Bosmer mage, and member of the Mages Guild part of the team excavating the Ayleid Ruins of Ezduiin.
Aesmer is an Altmer clothier residing in the city of Velyn Harbor, Malabal Tor. He can be found at his shop, The Impervious Pauldron, selling his wares.
Aeyne Redoran is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild who resides at the guildhall of Windhelm. She is also a member of House Redoran, one of the great houses of Morrowind.
Afneer Cold-Moon is a Nord stablemaster initially running his family's stables in Windhelm. He is later encountered again in the Hollow City, where he sells horses at the Coldharbour Mounts.
Afwa is a Redguard living with his companions Tholor the Dreg and Rinces in a treehouse just west of Karthdar, in the region of Grahtwood.
Agdesh is an Orsimer mystic found in the Mages Guild tent in Hoarfrost Downs.
Agganor is an Orsimer member of the Iron Orcs residing in Exarch's Stronghold, Craglorn.
Agila is a Nord patron of the Riverside Inn, in Nimalten. She has no unique dialogue.
Agilruin is a captive Bosmer sailor found in the Crimson Cove.
Aglion is a crazed Bosmer found sitting within Saltspray Cave. He is a former student of the College of Aldmeri Propriety and was put inside the cave as "punishment."
Agnar is an Orsimer warrior found at the Alcaire Castle, in the region of Stormhaven.
Agstarg is an Orsimer found at the Temple of the Eight in Grahtwood.
Agvar is a Nord found in Windhelm, in the region of Eastmarch.
Ah-Kajul is an Argonian scholar in who resides with Veth-Veidal in Veth-Veidal's House on the south side of Dhalmora.
Ah-Mudeska is an Argonian brewer, and resides in the The Gray Mire inn in the region of Grahtwood.
Ahaht-Malz is an Argonian working east of Headman Bhosek's Palace in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. She has no unique dialogue.
Ahainaz-daro is a Khajiit member of the Subtle Knife Gang. She is found inside the Realm of Baan Dar.
Aira is a Redguard priest found in the entrance chamber to Hel Ra Citadel. She provides the Undaunted delvers information on the dangers they would encounter.
Airia Twelve-Orcs is a Nord found in Windhelm. She is eating bread as part of the eating contest.
Ajac Viliane is a Breton residing in Dreughside, just outside of Wayrest, Stormhaven.
Akeenus is a blind Shadowscale found in the ruins of Loriasel.
Akgruhl gra-Bol is an Orsimer warrior and member of the Undaunted found at the enclave in Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Afinah is a Redguard who resides in the Caravan Company Depot, in the town of Dragonstar. She cannot be interacted with.
Akezel is a Dremora found in the Veteran City of Ash. She follows her master, Rukhan, into battle. They have a chance to drop Daedra Husks or Daedra Hearts.
Ahirunz is a Khajiit who can be found inside The Cave of Trophies. He is the mate of Ernabi. She died at the hands of the daedra when they took refuge inside the cave.
Aishah is a deceased Redguard residing in Hallin's Stand, Bangkorai, in . Before the Imperial invasion of the town, she was one of Captain Dhakir at-Nimr's soldiers.
Agalir is a Redguard Vampire hunter part of a group trying to slay a powerful vampire lord found in the ruins of Goldfolly.
Ahmat the Forgotten is a powerful Skeleton found inside the Ruins of Kardala.
Afflicted Commoner is a character residing in the town of Muth Gnaar.

Ajac Falbert is a Breton mystic and member of Mages Guild residing in the city of Orsinium. He can be found at his shop Soul and Stone, located on the second floor of the local guildhall's main hall, selling his wares.
Aitrabhi is a Khajiit found in the city of Orsinium. She is impossible to interact with.
Ahaht-Naat is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed in Fort Arand, Stonefalls.
Ak'saz is a Khajiit woodworker running a shop Wood-Whisker Carpentry in the Tumnosh Clanhold near the Graystone Quarry.
Aghurz is an Orsimer carpenter and proprietor of Palm-Blister Carpentry in Morkul Stronghold.
Airena is a Redguard beggar who resides in Jamadin's House in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. She has no unique dialogue. She will, however, act angrily to the Vestige for trespassing.
Afni is a Nord residing in Voljar's Meadery. They only appear in this location at the completion of the meadery's quests, however.
Aisarbana is a Khajiit found inside the castle in Anvil. She cannot be interacted with.
Agrius Vulso is an Imperial member of the Horsemen found at Silverhoof Vale in Rivenspire.
Ainamee is an Altmer soldier in Eagle's Strand, Khenarthi's Roost. She is injured, and can be found lying in the water.
Agolas is a Bosmer member of the Roadside Bandits found at Aqueduct Rock in Wrothgar.
Agrius Albutian is an Imperial residing inside his house in Kvatch.
Ahmanaz is a Khajiit member of the Saltwalker Militia. He is found at their camp in the Alik'r Desert.
Aihrima is a Khajiit mini-boss encountered during the Maelstrom Arena's fourth round.

Agnedir Forestborne was a Nord residing in a cabin near Bonestrewn Crest and the cousin of Selgaard Wood-Hewer and Jakild Wood-Hewer, as well as the sister of Alvor and Gabbi Forestborne. She was killed by draugr when they stormed out of the crypt.
Agka is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their guildhall in Windhelm.

Ahnat-Suna is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Ahemmusa Tribe, located in Ald'ruhn on Vvardenfell. As part of the celebration of Skar's defeat, she guards and prays to the cairn of the First Ashkhan of the Ahemmusa.
Airdeoza is a Khajiit residing in Tel Aruhn, in Vvardenfell. She is the property of Magister Gothren, a cruel master.
Agilgor is a Bosmer scholar and member of the Clockwork Apostles residing at The Cloisters inn in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. He has no unique dialoge.
Agral is an Orsimer member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. __NOTOC__
Aide Resetta is a Dunmer scholar and an ambassador's assistant located at the Skald-King's Temporary Court in Windhelm, Eastmarch.
Akatosh Sermonizer is a generic Imperial found in Kvatch. They cannot be interacted with.
Ahobi is a Redguard member of the Evermore City Guard. He is part of the squad sent to investigate the troubles of Murcien's Hamlet. He cannot be interacted with.
Ah-Shehs is an Argonian vossa-satl player, singer, and member of the Bright-Throat Tribe found in the Bright-Throat Village. He has no unique dialogue.
Akahmar is a Khajiit residing in Madashara's House in Rimmen.
Aerean is a Bosmer residing at a shrine of Mara in Valenwood. She is encountered alongside Belegond.
Ajim-Jaa is an Argonian warrior and resident of Lilmoth, Murkmire. Through a letter, Mach-Taeed is revealed to be his brother.
Ahmanra is a Khajiit innkeeper residing in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr.

Akha; also known as The First Cat, the Pathfinder, and the One Unmourned; is the first of the Khajiiti gods to whom Ahnurr and Fadomai gave birth. Akha is one of the "Wandering Spirits" of the Khajiiti pantheon. Akha was Ahnurr's favored son, and therefore Ahnurr told him to find love. By doing as his father told him, Akha had made the dragons, who are all his children, with his firstborn Alkhan being another spirit in the pantheon. After mating and making the dragons, Akha disappeared, with Alkosh appearing in his stead, speaking warnings of the things Akha had made.
Aethawn is a Bosmer located in Dreadsail Reef, High Isle and Amenos, in .
Afadi is a violent cultist residing in the Mnemonic Planisphere.

Albecius Colollius is an Imperial veteran battlemage. He is currently staying at Arrille's Tradehouse in Seyda Neen. People around Vvardenfell will tell the Nerevarine to speak with him if they are interested to know about the trade of the battlemage and how it is practiced in Morrowind. He can give information about armor styles, heavy armor styles, worn armor and worn weapons. When selecting the option Latest Rumors, he will say that some fool lost one of the powerful rings named Mentor's Ring in some tomb around Bitter Coast.

Alessia Ottus is an Imperial commoner renowned for her series of guide books of the various cities of Cyrodiil. She resides in the Imperial City, in which she owns a large house in the Imperial City Temple District where she, her husband Hastrel Ottus, and her daughter Ida Ottus live.

Alessia, also known as the "Slave-Queen", Perrif, or Al-Esh, and later canonized as "Saint Alessia", among other names, was a Nedic woman during the First Era. Responsible for ending human enslavement by the Ayleids, she founded the Alessian Empire and became its Empress and initiated worship of the Eight Divines. Upon her death, she became the first human saint. She is associated with the winged bull Morihaus, who is said to be her demigod lover.
Aldi is a Nord commoner who lives in her shack on the docks in Khuul, in the West Gash region, in a tiny house which contains nothing of value.

Alberic Litte is a Breton mage and member of the Chorrol Mages Guild, despite owning a house. Besides acting as a spell merchant, he is also a Journeyman level trainer in Conjuration. He will recommend those who are highly skilled with Conjuration consider seeking out Olyn Seran, a Daedra worshiper who can be found at the Molag Bal's Shrine. His wife, Carmen Litte, is proud of her husband's skill with Conjuration, and will often bring him up in conversation.
Alawen is a Bosmer archer located south of the Gold Road, between Kvatch and Anvil. Alawen is a master marksman trainer.
Aleron Loche is a Breton commoner and gambler who lives in Bravil, and is the husband of Ursanne Loche.

Albert Jemane was the father of Reynald Jemane and Guilbert Jemane, two brothers who were separated at a young age when Ogres attacked their family home, Weatherleah. He was once a member of the Thieves Guild, and was known for his ability to steal more difficult items. He was asked by Fathis Ules, a high-ranking member of the guild, to steal the Honorblade of Chorrol. While he stole the sword, he did not give it to the guild. He instead took his family and moved them to their new home on the middle of the Great Forest. They were all supposedly killed by the nearby Ogres, save for his son, Reynald, who was found wandering alone in the forest. While both of the sons survived, both Albert and
Alain Dufont is the leader of a bandit group which resides in Raldbthar. He is targeted by the Dark Brotherhood after offending his ex-lover, Muiri.
Alea Quintus is a Nord warrior whom the Dragonborn encounters in an abandoned shack at the start of the quest "With Friends Like These...."

Alessandra is an Imperial and Riften's priestess of Arkay. She is responsible for taking care of the Hall of the Dead, currently being the only priestess there and assuring that the dead are given the proper rituals and burial.
Alding is a Nord pirate in who is a member of the Blood Horker pirate clan under the captain Stig Salt-Plank. He only wears a Roughspun Tunic with no shoes.

Alarvyne Indalas is a Dunmer trader who resides in the St. Delyn Canton in Vivec City on the Ascadian Isles on Vvardenfell, Morrowind. She runs the Glassworker's Hall, a unique place where various glasswork is produced and sold.
Alavesa Samori is a Dunmer nightblade residing in the cave of Masseranit, in the Azura's Coast region. Alavesa, like the other bandits in the cave, will attack any intruders on sight.
Alds Baro is a Dunmer merchant and blacksmith, member of House Redoran who can be found at the Maar Gan Outpost.
Aldyne Arenim is a Dunmer pauper who resides in the St. Olms Canton of Vivec City.
Alenus Vendu is a Dunmer enchanter residing in the Services Tower of Tel Vos. She is a Lawman-ranked member of House Telvanni.
Alban Corinis is an Imperial knight and test character in . He appears in the Oblivion E3 demo.
Aldam Berendus is a Dunmer commoner and member of the East Empire Company living in Raven Rock. He is part of the quest "The Factor's Estate."

Aleri Aren is a Dunmer guard. She is located on the ground floor of the Guard Quarters of the Royal Palace in Mournhold near the exits to the Royal Palace Courtyard. She serves as a member of the Royal Guard and wears a full set of Royal Guard Armor.
Albense is a Breton scholar found in Stros M'Kai. He is in search of Dwemer relics for academic study, and can be found at the Screaming Mermaid.
Albec Dutheil is a Breton who resides in the city of Daggerfall. He can be found in the market, reading his notes. The dog Giblets may be found sitting beside him.
Aldimonwe is an Altmer who resides in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found at The Rosy Lion inn.
Akkuz the Beachwalker is a Khajiit in who is found walking the beach in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard.
Aldamaire is an Altmer noble residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood, Valenwood.
Alana Relin is a deceased Breton residing in Glenumbra Moors, Glenumbra, in .
Aldarenya is an Altmer residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood. She is a member of the Fighters Guild, and can be seen training with a Two Handed weapon.
Alard is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. He is found around town.
Aleen is a Redguard residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. She is found at the Crosswych Inn and she is worried about her husband Len Belland who has been taken prisoner by the Red Rook Bandits.
Alcedonia Amnis is an Imperial publican and a member of the East Empire Company residing in the Inn of Raven Rock, on the island of Solstheim.
Alandil is an Altmer alchemist residing in Rawl'kha. She owns the store The Cryptic Concoction.
Alanne is an Altmer member of the Fighters Guild and steward of the local guildhall in Shor's Stone, The Rift.
Alanwe is an Altmer spirit in that resides in the Crypt of Hearts, Rivenspire.
Alanya is an Altmer ghost who may be found in Valrendil's Cave in the region of Shadowfen.
Aldarch Colaste is an Altmer found in the Ayleid ruin of Torinaan, Auridon.
Aldunie is an Altmer in who resides outside Vulhkel Guard in the region of Auridon.
Alarel Dres is a Dunmer noble residing in his house in Mournhold. He is the husband of the necromancer Mirise Dres.
Aldi Winterblade is a Nord residing in the Banking District in Mournhold.
Aldarnen is a Bosmer residing in the city of Marbruk. He can often be encountered mourning and praying in the cemetery, lamenting his fate.
Aldryn Dres is a Dunmer slaver and member of House Dres residing in the city of Ebonheart.

Mane Akkhuz-ri is a Khajiit in who is the current Mane, the spiritual leader of his people, as of 2E 582. He is often accompanied by his Speaker and loyal friend, Lord Gharesh-ri. The Vestige meets him during the quest "Retaking the Pass" where he is trapped in an Old Merchant's Cave at Driladan Pass in Greenshade. Later in Malabal Tor, he is on his way to the Silvenar's Wedding, until he becomes possessed by the Dark Mane and flees to Reaper's March. As the Dark Mane, Akkhuz-ri terrorized Reaper's March using the Dro-m'Athra, until he was ultimately set free of the Dark Mane's control by the Vestige.
Aklief is a Nord brewer working at the Riverside Inn in Nimalten.
Akovor is a Nord living in a house near Piukanda. He owns a dog named Lehrsjon.
Akvid Gray-Sky is a Nord patron of The Horker's Tusk Tavern in Ivarstead.
Alahir is a Redguard mystic and member of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Daggerfall.
Alander Stickyfoot is a Bosmer traveler in who can be randomly encountered in Eastmarch alongside his companion Maenrin.
Alandis is a Bosmer found on the road between Elden Root and Cormount in the region of Grahtwood, Valenwood. She lives in the village of Karthdar.
Aldam Urvyn is a Dunmer Guild trader. He sells his wares at his kiosk, Traitor's Trades, in Hoarfrost Downs.
Aldferth Two-Maces is a Nord lumberjack found in Thulvald's Logging Camp.
Aldyna is a Dunmer slaver who can be found east of Camp Crystal Abattoir. She is looking for Suriel, one of her slaves who recently escaped.
Alesah is a Redguard residing in the city of Sentinel, Alik'r Desert.
Alameric Dailon is an undead skeleton that appears in . It is the boss of Tribulation Crypt in Rivenspire.
Alana is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild in who resides at their guildhall in Vulkwasten.
Akranos the Unleashed is a powerful Mantikora found inside the ruins of Skyreach Hold.
Akkra gra-Korma is an Orsimer warrior, and a member of the Iron Orcs clan. She is found within the ruins of Skyreach Hold, Craglorn.

Alessiac Barthel is a Breton found at the Temple of Ire in the city of Orsinium. He can not be interacted with, but can be seen listening to the readings of the book of Trinimac by Ordatha, together with Aeedika and Medar Othralas.
Alcedonia Delitian is an Imperial found inside the Great Chapel of Dibella in Anvil.
Alaird Dutil is a Breton residing in Evermore. He owns The Bay Tar's Mess.

Alalura is a Dunmer in who is found with her companion Mylis at their campsite at one of their possible locations in Malabal Tor. The Vestige can light their fire as part of the Lightbringer achievement.
Alavesa Arethan is a Dunmer residing in Seyda Neen on Vvardenfell. She may appear outside Vivec City when first entering the city.
Alberic Drenim is a Dunmer noble residing in the Saint Olms Waistworks in the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Aleron Sylbenitte is a Breton laborer residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. He has no unique dialogue.
Aleri Marys is a character residing in Balmora, in Vvardenfell.

Aksel Rockbiter is an Orsimer adventurer. He may become the personal blacksmithing hireling for the Vestige, should they choose to allocate points into the Miner Hireling skill for blacksmithing, once they reach the appropriate level. He will send a letter with select materials to the Vestige on a daily basis, although the items he sends may be improved with additional points into the Miner Hireling skill.
Alcorana is an Altmer residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. She once worked in the Gnisis Egg Mine, but has fallen prey to the sound emanating from the depths of the mine.
Alarvyne Falas is a Dunmer scholar and member of the Clockwork Apostles who can be found in Barilzar's Eighth Laboratory in Mire Mechanica, Clockwork City.

Aldarch Tilcalar is an Altmer found in an argument at the front gate of the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He transferred to the Monastery of Serene Harmony at the request of Kinlady Avinisse, but has since closed it to newcomers.
Akumjhargo is a Pahmar-raht Khajiit world boss found at Red Hands Run with his sister Zav'i. He uses melee attacks.
Alamorto is a Bosmer in wanting to join the Witchmother coven. He only appears during the "Witches Festival" event. He can be found at Olyve's Brewery in either Auridon, Glenumbra or Stonefalls.
Aklobesh is an Orsimer member of the Roister's Club encountered in the club's various chapters. Her appeareance and rank are randomized.
Alaburani is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Ahemmusa Tribe residing in the Ahemmusa Camp in Vvardenfell.

Akorithi was the Redguard Queen of the city-state of Sentinel in Hammerfell. She and her husband, Camaron of Sentinel, ruled a large swathe of land in northern Hammerfell. However, her husband was killed at the Battle of Cryngaine Field during the War for Betony, and she was forced to step down from her position as Queen of Sentinel. She produced two male heirs for Camaron, Greklith and Lhotun, and gave birth to their eldest child and daughter Aubk'i. Sometime after the agent of Uriel Septim VII helped Prince Lhotun gain information about the eldest son of the royal family of Sentinel, he received a summons from Queen Akorithi. The Queen asked the agent to retrieve a painting from somewhere
Allding is a Nord pawnbroker who works at the Rat and the Pot tavern in Ald'ruhn. He is a member of the Thieves Guild.
Allena Benoch was a Bosmer blademistress, master of Valenwood Fighters Guild and a member of Imperial Guard.

Alfe Fyr is a Dunmer spellsword who resides in Tel Fyr, Morrowind. One of the four daughters of Divayth Fyr (and considered the smartest), she was created by him, as a "side benefit of the researches into corprus disease." She now exists solely to serve her master, Divayth Fyr. She can be found in the hall of Fyr. Her three sisters are Beyte Fyr, Delte Fyr, and Uupse Fyr.
Almse Arenim is a Dunmer agent who resides in Gnaar Mok and who owns Arenim Manor. She is a member of House Hlaalu.
Alvor is a Nord blacksmith living in the village of Riverwood, the husband of Sigrid and father to Dorthe. He can also serve as the introductory quest to Smithing.
Allian Carbo is an Imperial warrior who resides in the city of Gnisis. He is a member of the Imperial Legion.

Alves Uvenim is a Dunmer merchant in the Leyawiin Mages Guild. She has a selection of spells, magic-related goods and ingredients for sale. She is also a member of the Mages Guild. Alves is not comfortable with how the Leyawiin chapter of the Guild is doing. She says that she feels it is "just drifting along," and that its leader, Dagail, does not really lead. She also adds that she does not feel like going to Dagail when she needs help, and prefers going to Agata instead. While not a Daedra worshiper herself, she seems well studied on several matters relating to the subject. She is able to identify the Staff of the Everscamp, and also knows the location of the Shrine of Nocturnal.
Alga is a Nord bard living in Honmund's House, just inside the eastern gate to Bruma. She is an Apprentice Speechcraft trainer and is known around town to be an excellent Bard.

Algot the Northerner is a Nord citizen living in his house in the Imperial City. He can be found roaming the Market District near The Best Defense. He may be seen working in one of the Imperial Trading Company Warehouses from 9 AM to 6 PM. He says that he has given up adventuring except for when he needs gold. Once a month, he leaves the city and heads to Bruma. He will stay there for a little over a day, sleeping at the Jerall View Inn.

Alonzo is a Redguard leader and member of the Black Bows, along with Roxy Aric and their leader, Black Brugo. He can be found in the Ayleid Ruin of Telepe which is close to the city of Leyawiin. In combat, Alonzo wears leveled light armor, and carries a blunt weapon.

Alodie Jes is a Breton warrior living in Ebonheart. He is also a member of the Imperial Legion. He is imprisoned in the Hawkmoth Legion Garrison in Ebonheart. If his door is unlocked, he will refuse to leave.

Alfhedil Elf-Hewer is a Nord barbarian who resides in the Upper levels of Falensarano, Morrowind. He is friendly to towards the Nerevarine and he is master trainer in axe, blunt weapons and medium armor.

Alof the Easterner is a Nord farmer who resides in his farmhouse, in Vvardenfell, Morrowind. He is having trouble with a group of Orcs harassing the local farmers and has hired the Fighters Guild to deal with the problem.

Alfarinn is a Nord carriage driver in who can be found at the stables outside Windhelm. His carriage may be hired to travel to any of the hold capitals. If attacked, he will jump off of his carriage and proceed to defend against his attacker. Attempting to steal from him will show nothing in his inventory. Only after being assaulted and killed can anything be taken from him.
Alfhild Battle-Born is a Nord farmer of the Battle-Born clan in who resides in Whiterun.

The Alik'r Prisoner is a member of the Alik'r. He has been sent to capture Saadia and bring her back to Hammerfell for her betrayal of her people in favor of the Third Aldmeri Dominion, but was caught and imprisoned by the Whiterun Guard.
Alisanne Dupre was the Listener to the Night Mother during the Great War in Cyrodiil. She was the last Listener in Cyrodiil, as well as the Listener previous to the Dragonborn.
Althel was a Bosmer archer who resided in Vitharn, Shivering Isles.
Alexia Vici is an Imperial noblewoman in . She is the mother of Vittoria Vici and the aunt of the Emperor Titus Mede II.
Alms Helothren is a Dunmer thief who resides in Zenarbael, in Molag Amur region. Like the other bandits in the cave, Alms is hostile to any intruders, and will attack them on sight.
Almsi Oren is a Dunmer battlemage and slaver who resides in the cave of Habinbaes, in Sheogorad region, Morrowind. Like the rest of the slavers in the cave, she is hostile and will attack on sight.

Alnas Sendu is a Dunmer Rogue who resides in the slaver cave of Hinnabi, in the Ascadian Isles region. Although not a member of the Thieves Guild, he may be paid to clear the Nerevarine of any bounty.

Aloie Indaram is a Dunmer archer, and a member of the bandit gang that has occupied the Dunmer stronghold of Andasreth, in the West Gash region. She is located on the rooftop of the upper level, and is hostile towards the Nerevarine.
Alonisea Varys is a Dunmer rogue who resides in the cave Abanabi, Abernanit, in the Bitter Coast region. She is hostile towards the Nerevarine, and will attack them on sight.
Alurue Saryon is a Dunmer witchhunter who resides in the cave of Kunirai, in Molag Amur region.
Alvela Saram is a Dunmer crusader and member of the Tribunal Temple who resides in the Temple Canton of Vivec City.
Alven Salas is a Dunmer monk and member of the Morag Tong who resides in the Sadrith Mora Morag Tong Guild. He is in position of a ring known as Black Jinx.
Alveno Andules is a Dunmer pawnbroker and member of House Hlaalu who lives in the Hlaalu Canton of Vivec City. She runs the Hlaalu Pawnbroker shop in Vivec City.
Alvis Teri is a Dunmer rogue who resides in the Eight Plates inn in Balmora.
Alvor Andas is a Dunmer miner who resides in Abaelun Mine, in the West Gash region.

Alvos Sadri is a Dunmer knight who resides in the cave of Kumarahaz, in the Azura's Coast region. Alvos, like the other bandits in Kimarahaz, is hostile to towards the Nerevarine, and will attack them on sight.
Alvur Hleran is a Dunmer thief who resides in the cave of Beshara, in the Ascadian Isles region. Both Alvur and Dondir have angered Tinos Drothan, a former employer whom they stole from.
Aliera was a fictional character from the King Edward series of books. In the series, she is the mother of the main character, Edward, and the wife of Dunmer Moraelyn.
Alvring Whitebeard is a Nord Skaal warrior found in his village, in the north-eastern part of Solstheim.
Alvide is a Nord citizen currently seeking refuge in Fort Dawnguard.

The All-Maker is the deity venerated by the Skaal on the island of Solstheim. Unlike the pantheons of other cultures across Tamriel, the All-Maker is the sole deity in their faith, giving the faith a unique monotheistic quality.

Alvan Llarys is a Dunmer noble who can be found in Sadri Manor at the district of Godsreach, Mournhold. Together with Tadera Andules, he takes care of Golena Sadri as she is becoming mentally fragile.
Alveleg is a Bosmer scout and member of the Thieves Guild who resides outside Ashanammu in the West Gash region.
Ama Nin is a Breton healer found in the caves beneath Berandas.

Alusannah is a Redguard crusader in . She is found within the Royal Palace of Mournhold guarding Barenziah in the queen's chambers. She is a member of the Royal Guard and wears a full set of Royal Guard Armor.
Alumezi is a Khajiit spy for the Aldmeri Dominion in Bangkorai.

Am-Ra is an Argonian Slave residing in the cave of Sinsibadon, where she and her fellows are held captive by a gang of slavers. To free her, Borug gro-Lazgarn, the leader of the gang, must be killed and looted for the key to their bindings.
Allimir is a Bosmer barbarian who resides in Assumanu, in the Sheogorad region.
Amable Onis is a Breton residing in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He is typically found on Daggerfall Docks.
Alyxe is a hag alchemist that can be found east of the Gil-Var-Delle Wayshrine in Grahtwood.
Alexia Dencent is a Breton residing south of Aldcroft, Glenumbra, in . She lives in her father's cottage beside the Aldcroft Lighthouse. Her father, Edrien Dencent, is deceased.
Alofheim Cold-Eye is a Nord found at the Stonetooth Fortress' docks.
Althah is a Redguard residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood. She is a member of the Fighters Guild.
Alinon the Alchemist is a Breton alchemist residing in Camlorn, Glenumbra, in . He is found in the chapel inside the city as well as in Crosswych, and also in Frostbreak Fortress, Wrothgar, in

Alvuin is a Breton residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. He is typically found sitting on a small boat at the docks, near Lokra. Beside him is the Letter from Peverel, but it is not addressed to him.
Ama Loche is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle, located inside the Old Goat Inn.
Also-He-Washes is a deceased Argonian slave whose body may be found in the cave of Sjobal.
Alfbrand is a Nord barbarian and member of the false Skaal tribe on Solstheim. He can be found either in the Raven Rock Mine or wandering the wilds of the Hirstaang Forest region.
Alisewen is an Altmer guild trader residing in the city of Windhelm. She can be found selling her wares at her store, Windswept Stalls.
